item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:20 HKT 16/Feb/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of southern China today and tomorrow. It will be slightly cooler over the region. Under the influence of a humid maritime airstream, it will be foggy over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week, and it will be warm during the day. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach the coast of southern China in the latter part of next week. Temperatures will fall appreciably over the region.
